[[File:Light_Y-wing.png|thumb|The various angles of the Light Y-wings.]]
The '''Light Y-wing''' was a small-scale version of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was equipped with a single forward [[laser cannon]] and a single chute capable of deploying [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]]. It could be distinguished from other Y-wing models by the lack of extended thrust vectral struts on its [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]], and was used primarily by smaller Rebel cells for attacking surface targets.
